description: List the UI components of Ionic Framework, optionally filtered by a keyword. Use this to find the component that fits a piece of UI before building it by hand, and to learn the custom element name it is used under. Use limit 100 to list every component. Returns `tag`, `description` and `url` per component, where `url` is the documentation page carrying its full API reference. Do not use this to read a component's API: call `get_doc_page` with the returned `url`. Do not use it for Capacitor plugins or native capabilities, which are covered by the Capacitor MCP server at https://capacitor-mcp.capawesome.io/mcp.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return, e.g. 5. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

query.description: A free-text filter matching the tag or the description, e.g. "modal". Defaults to no filter. Optional.

version.description: Optional. Ionic Framework docs version. Defaults to v9. Match the major version of @ionic/core (or @ionic/angular, @ionic/react, @ionic/vue) in the user's package.json.

name: list_components
title: List Ionic Framework components
